location.zarya.name: Zarya
location.zarya.desc: A former military town, now a trade hub. The walls are patched, two men with shotguns guard the gate. Inside: a market, a hospital, and a never-ending queue for water.
location.zarya.ambient.1: Smells of machine oil and damp.
location.zarya.ambient.2: A dog barks somewhere beyond the wall — and falls silent.
location.zarya.ambient.3: A tin sign above the gate reads: 'Welcome. Surrender your weapons.'
location.ash_road.name: Ash Road
location.ash_road.desc: Broken asphalt, rusted car bodies along the shoulders. The Rot hasn't reached here yet, but breathing is hard.
location.ash_road.ambient.1: Wind drives grey dust along the cracks in the asphalt.
location.ash_road.ambient.2: Somewhere far away a torn door slams — then silence again.
location.old_crossing.name: Old Crossing
location.old_crossing.desc: A crossroads of two highways. The sign rotted away long ago, only the post remains. Open ground — you won't pass unseen.
location.old_crossing.ambient.1: The post creaks in the wind.
location.old_crossing.ambient.2: Old tire tracks on the asphalt, already filled with mud.
location.pepel.name: Pepel
location.pepel.desc: A mining town by the pit. They don't like strangers here, but they value strong hands. In the center: the mine, around it: barracks, a forge, and a shop.
location.pepel.ambient.1: Cold and wet earth breathe from the mine.
location.pepel.ambient.2: A dim lamp burns above the mine entrance.
location.pepel.ambient.3: Someone curses in the barracks — then goes quiet.
location.pine_guard.name: Pine Outpost
location.pine_guard.desc: Remains of a forest outpost. The pines stand unevenly, as if something scared them. You can easily take cover behind the crates by the wall.
location.pine_guard.ambient.1: Smells of pine resin and smoke.
location.pine_guard.ambient.2: A woodpecker knocks somewhere — the only sound around.
location.pine_forest.name: Pine Forest
location.pine_forest.desc: Old pines, fallen trunks, moss. The Rot hasn't reached here yet, but the beasts have. Something rustles in the bushes.
location.pine_forest.ambient.1: The pines creak in the wind.
location.pine_forest.ambient.2: Small wildlife scurries from under your feet.
location.pine_forest.ambient.3: A branch snaps deep inside. Maybe a beast. Maybe a man.
location.quiet_domes.name: Quiet Domes
location.quiet_domes.desc: A former military base. Antenna domes are overgrown with moss, the gates are ajar. Inside: darkness and the traces of someone's feet.
location.quiet_domes.ambient.1: The wind hums in the empty antennas.
location.quiet_domes.ambient.2: Water drips somewhere — steady as a metronome.
location.rotten_hollow.name: Rotten Hollow
location.rotten_hollow.desc: A hollow where the Rot feels at home. The air is heavy, sweetish. Your head buzzes — something seems to whisper.
location.rotten_hollow.ambient.1: The air is thick as syrup.
location.rotten_hollow.ambient.2: Mushrooms crunch underfoot — and the smell makes you sick.
location.institute_9.name: Institute-9
location.institute_9.desc: A former biotech institute. Windows smashed, doors torn off, but something hums inside — meaning there's power. They say the lab still works.
location.institute_9.ambient.1: You can hear a transformer humming deep inside.
location.institute_9.ambient.2: A torn poster on the wall reads 'Safety First'.
location.mine_entrance.name: Mine Entrance
location.mine_entrance.desc: The entrance to the mine, lined with rusted iron. Dark inside, but it smells of fresh earth. You can take cover behind the crates by the wall.
location.mine_entrance.ambient.2: A shadow crawls along the wall — maybe a rat, maybe something bigger.
location.mine_entrance.ambient.3: The wind blows dry leaves into the mine.
location.deep_mine.name: Deep Drift
location.deep_mine.desc: The lower level of the mine. Heavy air, something stirs in the dark. They say the Rot is especially strong here.
location.deep_mine.ambient.1: The silence is so deep you can hear your own breathing.
location.deep_mine.ambient.2: A rustle from the dark. Then another.
location.waste_edge.name: Waste Edge
location.waste_edge.desc: Open ground, wind, sparse stones. The Rot hasn't taken root here yet, but the air already smells of damp.
location.waste_edge.ambient.1: The wind whistles between the stones.
location.waste_edge.ambient.2: The stones are covered with sparse grey moss.
item.rusty_pipe.name: Rusty Pipe
item.rusty_pipe.desc: Heavy, with flaking paint. Hurts if it connects.
item.hunting_knife.name: Hunting Knife
item.hunting_knife.desc: The blade darkened with blood, but still sharp.
item.fire_axe.name: Fire Axe
item.fire_axe.desc: Heavy, with a red handle. Hits rarely, but hard.
item.sawnoff.name: Sawn-off
item.sawnoff.desc: Two barrels, cut short. Point-blank power — but slow to reload.
item.army_pistol.name: Army Pistol
item.army_pistol.desc: A surviving specimen. Eight rounds, and you're human again.
item.rusty_carbine.name: Rusty Carbine
item.rusty_carbine.desc: The barrel is rusted, but the mechanism works. Accurate if your hands don't shake.
item.leather_jacket.name: Leather Jacket
item.canvas_pants.name: Canvas Pants
item.worn_boots.name: Worn Boots
item.worn_boots.desc: The sole is worn, but the feet don't freeze.
item.welder_mask.name: Welder's Mask
item.welder_mask.desc: Protects face and head. Poor visibility, but the head stays intact.
item.army_vest.name: Army Vest
item.army_vest.desc: Heavy, punctured in a couple of spots, but the Kevlar holds.
item.spore_cloak.name: Spore Cloak
item.spore_cloak.desc: Made of dense cloth soaked in something resinous. Smells of mushrooms, but the Rot won't take it.
item.medkit.name: Medkit
item.medkit.desc: Bandage, iodine, and a plaster. All you need.
item.bandage.name: Bandage
item.spore_antidote.name: Rot Antidote
item.spore_antidote.desc: Cloudy liquid in a syringe. They say it helps against spores.
item.stimpack.name: Stimpack
item.stimpack.desc: Army stimulant. Hits the blood like a hammer.
item.ammo_light.name: Light Ammo
item.ammo_medium.name: Medium Ammo
item.ammo_heavy.name: Heavy Ammo
item.ammo_heavy.desc: Large caliber. Rare to come by.
item.scrap_metal.name: Scrap Metal
item.rat_pelt.name: Rat Pelt
item.rat_pelt.desc: Grey-brown, still warm. Valued by furriers.
item.spore_sample.name: Spore Sample
item.spore_sample.desc: A jar of grey dust. Smells sweetish. Scientists pay well.
item.old_coin.name: Old Coin
item.old_coin.desc: A coin with a double-headed eagle. No longer money, but collectors take them.
item.army_tag.name: Army tag
item.army_tag.desc: A metal medallion with a serial number. In the wasteland it replaces money: they are found in the stomachs of rats that ate people. They don't spoil and can't be forged.
item.military_flashlight.name: Military Flashlight
item.military_flashlight.desc: Heavy, with a rusted button. It works — and that's a miracle already.
item.sniper_rifle.name: Sniper Rifle
item.sniper_rifle.desc: A smooth barrel, an adjustable scope. One hit and the conversation is over.
item.machine_gun.name: Machine Gun
item.machine_gun.desc: Heavy, overheats, devours ammo belt-fed. But nobody argues with it.
item.hitech_vest.name: Hi-Tech Vest
item.hitech_vest.desc: A composite plate rig from pre-Rot warehouses. Light and almost impenetrable.
item.big_medkit.name: Large Medkit
item.big_medkit.desc: Everything you need: a tourniquet, antibiotics, a bandage for any occasion.
item.stimulant.name: Stimulant
item.stimulant.desc: A syringe of muck and amphetamine. Blocks pain and stun — then you sleep for a day.
mob.pipe_rat.name: Pipe Rodent
mob.pipe_rat.desc: A rat the size of a dog. Lives in pipes, eats whatever it finds.
mob.ash_dog.name: Ash Hound
mob.ash_dog.desc: A stray dog, mangy and mean. Usually packs, but bites even alone.
mob.spore_youth.name: Spore Youth
mob.spore_youth.desc: A teenager the Rot took recently. Not yet lost human shape, but no longer human.
mob.rust_digger.name: Rust Digger
mob.rust_digger.desc: A marauder with a pickaxe. Looks for what's poorly guarded. Doesn't like sharing.
mob.rot_walker.name: Rot Walker
mob.rot_walker.desc: A corpse the Rot raised and forced to walk. Slow, but tough.
mob.rat_elder.name: Elder Rat
mob.rat_elder.desc: A rat the size of a calf. Pack leader. Hits hard and accurately.
mob.bandit_scout.name: Bandit Scout
mob.bandit_scout.desc: Thin, fast, with a knife. Watches first, strikes later.
mob.bandit_brute.name: Bandit Brute
mob.bandit_brute.desc: A mountain of muscle with a sawn-off. Thinks slow, hits hard.
mob.spore_hound.name: Spore Hound
mob.spore_hound.desc: A dog the Rot remade into a hunter. Fast, mean, with fungal growths on its back.
mob.spore_priest.name: Spore Priest
mob.spore_priest.desc: A former human, now a servant of the Rot. Speaks with it and strikes with calculation.
mob.rust_hulk.name: Rust Hulk
mob.rust_hulk.desc: A mountain of spore-flesh encrusted with scrap. Slow, but kills in one blow.
mob.gray_widow.name: Grey Widow
mob.gray_widow.desc: A giant spider whose eyes glow in the dark. Weaves webs in mines and ruins.
mob.bandit_shooter.name: Bandit Gunman
mob.bandit_shooter.desc: A bandit with a sawn-off under his coat. Keeps his distance and shoots to kill.
mob.spore_shooter.name: Spore Gunner
mob.spore_shooter.desc: A soul-lost shooter whose bullets are soaked in spores. Fires from afar and flees.

npc.koval.name: Old Man Koval
npc.koval.line.1: Pipes bend, people break. I only fix the first kind.
npc.koval.line.2: Rust is not dirt, kid. It's the patina of time. Don't wipe it off.
npc.koval.line.3: The war is over, yet nails are still scarce. Funny, huh?
npc.koval.line.4: Don't touch the anvil. It's older than you and, apparently, meaner.
npc.koval.line.5: You pay in army tags, you get iron. Fair as it gets in this district.
npc.koval.line.6: Rats in the wasteland eat people. Sometimes with their tags. Kill a rat — look inside, you might get lucky.
npc.koval.rumor.1: They say the doors at Institute Nine open by themselves. And it's not a draft.
npc.vera.name: Vera
npc.vera.line.1: Sit down. If the blood isn't yours — wipe it up yourself.
npc.vera.line.2: Antibiotics ran out last century. Literally.
npc.vera.line.3: Want to live long? Stay out of the wasteland. Ha. Kidding. No one ever does.
npc.vera.line.4: I've seen people die of bullets, of spores, and of boredom. The last one is quickest.
npc.vera.line.5: Nice scar. In another life you'd have made a fine doctor.
npc.vera.line.6: Will you pay in tags, or with the story of where all those holes came from?
npc.vera.rumor.1: They whisper that Molchun in Pepel spoke once. Just once. On the eve of the collapse.
npc.vera.rumor.2: They found a fridge at Institute Nine. Fully stocked. Nobody dared to open the second shelf.
npc.molchun.name: Molchun
npc.molchun.line.1: The mine doesn't let go. I walked out; it didn't.
npc.molchun.line.2: It's dark down there not for lack of lamps. The light just refuses to live there.
npc.molchun.line.3: I'm quiet not out of pride. Who is there to talk to? The timbering?
npc.molchun.line.4: Tags jingle. People don't. That's the whole economy.
npc.molchun.line.5: Asking about the Border? Don't go there. Everyone who did is part of it now.
npc.molchun.rumor.1: They say there's another mine level under Pepel. Nobody dug it. It dug itself out.
npc.molchun.rumor.2: The rats in the deep drift are especially fat. Must have eaten more than one company.
